organizations_read.name: organizations_read
organizations_read.using: "organizations"."id" = nullif(current_setting('app.organization_id', true), '')::uuid or "organizations"."id" in (select organization_id from memberships where user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid)

organizations_platform_read.name: organizations_platform_read
organizations_platform_read.using: "organizations"."is_demo" and nullif(current_setting('app.staff_id', true), '')::uuid is not null
